claim: Claude Code runs one prompt headless with `claude -p <prompt> --output-format stream-json --verbose`; when a skill runs, the stream carries a tool call named Skill whose input names the skill.

value.fired: assistant message, tool_use name Skill, input.skill

sources.title: Our test: Claude Code 2.1.299 asked to run a test skill

notes: Observed event: tool_use Skill {"skill":"fieldcheck-plain"}. A plugin's skill may carry the plugin's prefix (plugin:skill), which trigger strips.

claim: Codex runs one prompt headless with `codex exec --skip-git-repo-check --json <prompt>`, and only once its standard input is closed; when a skill runs, Codex reads the skill's SKILL.md with a shell command, which the event stream shows.

sources.title: Our test: Codex 0.159.3 asked to run a test skill

notes: With --json and standard input left open, codex exec 0.159.3 waited and printed nothing; with it closed it ran at once. Observed event: command_execution "cat .agents/skills/fieldcheck-plain/SKILL.md".

claim: The Antigravity CLI runs one prompt headless with `agy -p <prompt> --output-format stream-json`; when a skill runs, a view_file step opens the skill's SKILL.md.

sources.title: Our test: Antigravity CLI 1.4.2 asked to run a test skill

claim: Gemini CLI activates a skill by calling its activate_skill tool.
notes: Not run here: Gemini CLI 0.62.0 refuses free personal accounts (skills.gemini-cli.individuals-closed). The stream-json event shape for activate_skill is not confirmed, so trigger marks Gemini results unverified.

claim: Antigravity's plugin validator (agy plugin validate --strict, CLI 1.4.2) warns that a plugin's root AGENTS.md is never loaded, because a plugin's rules load only from rules/; without --strict it passes.

sources.title: Our test: agy plugin validate on a repository written by skill-builder repo new

notes: The root AGENTS.md is the guide for agents working on the repository (Codex and others read it there), not a rule for the plugin's users, so it stays where it is and the strict warning is expected.
